facts.text: Snow left Olallie Meadows (4,010 ft) and Tinkham Creek (3,000 ft) 13 to 21 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Olallie Meadows
evidence.detail: left May 20; earlier seasons: June 10 (2023), June 17 (2024), June 7 (2025)

evidence.name: Tinkham Creek
evidence.detail: left May 2; earlier seasons: May 30 (2023), May 15 (2024), May 12 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at Olallie Meadows (4,010 ft) and Tinkham Creek (3,000 ft).

evidence.name: Olallie Meadows
evidence.detail: 24.9 in on April 3; earlier seasons: 60.3 in (2023), 45.2 in (2024), 45.1 in (2025)

evidence.name: Tinkham Creek
evidence.detail: 11.4 in on April 2; earlier seasons: 30.2 in (2023), 15.6 in (2024), 17.0 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between April 27 and June 26, carried from the melt-out dates at 3 nearby stations to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Olallie Meadows
evidence.detail: melted out May 20, 626 ft below the pass; points to May 5 to June 26

evidence.name: Mount Gardner
evidence.detail: melted out April 4, 1,706 ft below the pass; points to March 31 to June 7

evidence.name: Tinkham Creek
evidence.detail: melted out May 2, 1,636 ft below the pass; points to April 27 to July 3
